alerts.removeProject.title: Remove «{name}» from AYAR?
alerts.removeProject.detail: This project’s runs and evidence are deleted from AYAR. The repository is not touched.
alerts.deleteRuns.title: {count, plural, one {Delete this run?} other {Delete # runs?}}
alerts.deleteRuns.detail: These runs and their evidence are deleted from AYAR; the repository is not touched. This cannot be undone.
alerts.removeTool.title: Remove {name} from AYAR?
alerts.removeTool.detail: This version is deleted from AYAR’s toolbox; checks that need it become «Missing» until it is installed again.
alerts.purgeData.title: Delete all AYAR data?
alerts.purgeData.detail: Added projects, their runs and evidence, and downloaded tools are deleted from this Mac. No repository is touched. This cannot be undone.
